title: MR-KEP Certification Record
description: Output of the Certification Agent: a whisky's full certified knowledge vector, each field backed by an evidence record. This is the object promoted into production on a later apply gate.

whisky_key.description: Deterministic normalized whisky identifier used for matching.

confidence_min.description: Minimum field confidence across all certified fields; must be >= certify_min (0.70).

fields.description: Canonical field name -> certified value (already normalized).

evidence_index.description: One evidence.schema.json record per certified field.

certification_state.description: Aggregate certification state across all fields.

confidence_overall.description: Overall confidence across all certified fields.

run_id.description: Identifier for the pipeline run that produced this record.

audit_status.description: Set by Audit Agent after certification.
